name: THE MALL
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 453, 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428 (roofs and cover); ask row 468's list, the fifth: 'THE MALL (Fashion Show; the Forum Shops' painted sky): stores as tiles, the atrium, the escalators.'
facts: Fashion Show on the Strip is about 1.9 million square feet with some 250 stores (its owner's figure); one wing of one level is hundreds of house tiles, so a fight takes a stretch of one concourse: eight stores and the atrium between them.

The Forum Shops at Caesars has a barrel ceiling painted as a sky that used to turn from dawn to dusk on a timer; the mall's ceiling here is that sky, the paint let go, with a skylight along the concourse.

A dead mall is a real thing with a real look (the country's dead malls, photographed for years): shutters stuck half down, planters with nothing alive in them, the food court's chairs still bolted to the floor, people living in the stores.
The map's own word for a mall in the collapse (slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html): 'shelter, then a supply riot, then quiet'.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (mall_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The mall is the one map kind with a concourse of stores. The parking garage takes its own share there first (garage.json); of the rest, this share is fought inside the mall, by the cell's own dice; the rest on the lot outside.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words).

wall.effect: The mall's outer wall: no way through.

storewall.effect: The wall between two stores: no way through, no sight through.

front.effect: A store's front, its glass boarded over: no way through, no sight through. The doorway beside it is the way in.

floor.effect: The concourse between the store fronts: open floor, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.
floor.say: The concourse: open floor, nothing to hide behind.

carpet.effect: A store's floor: walls on three sides, one way in. Nothing on it to hide behind, but only the doorway sees you.
carpet.say: A store's floor: walls round you, one way in.

shutter.effect: A store's doorway, the shutter stuck half down: you duck under it, slow going (3 AP a step). One man at a time: the way in is the way out.
shutter.say: The shutter, half down: slow going, one at a time.

carts.effect: A corral of shopping carts: low cover (some against a shot).
carts.say: A corral of carts: low cover.

stock.effect: Stock still on its pallets, picked over: cover.

counter.effect: The store's counter and the shelves behind it: low cover.

camp.effect: Somebody lives in this store: bedding and what they carried in. Low cover.

planter.effect: A concrete planter, what grew in it dead: low cover.

tables.effect: The food court's tables and chairs, bolted down: slow going (3 AP a step) and low cover.
tables.say: The food court's tables: slow going, low cover.

kiosk.effect: A kiosk in the middle of the concourse: cover.

rubble.effect: Where a piece of the ceiling came down: cover.

column.effect: A column: nobody stands on its tile.

lift.effect: The lift's shaft, its doors shut for good: nobody stands on its tile.

fire.effect: A fire in a drum somebody keeps. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A drum fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

skylight.effect: Under the skylight: open floor, and by day the light comes straight down: a man here is seen.
skylight.say_lit: Under the skylight: open floor, and the day is on you.

doors.effect: The mall's own doors, the glass gone: open floor, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The mall's doors: open floor, and the day is on you.

high.effect: The bridge of the upper level across the atrium, a storey up: high ground in the middle of the mall, and nobody's at the bell. A blow or a shot down from it lands easier, one up at it harder; a gun reaches a tile farther from it. Up a dead escalator it is a walk; over its rail from the floor it is a climb: no attack that turn, and a beast cannot.
high.say: The bridge: you hit down easier, and a gun reaches a tile more.

high_stock.effect: Stock somebody hauled up onto the bridge: cover, on high ground. The best ground in the mall.
high_stock.say: Stock on the bridge: cover, and high ground.

high_planter.effect: A planter on the bridge: low cover, on high ground.
high_planter.say: A planter on the bridge: low cover, and high ground.

ramp.effect: A dead escalator: the WALK up to the bridge. A step onto it from the floor costs one more; a man who walks up can still strike this turn.
ramp.say_before: The escalator, dead: the walk up, and you can still strike.

display.effect: A store's window display, what is left of it: mannequins still dressed, some down. Low cover.

fountain.effect: The atrium's fountain, dry, coins still in it: nobody stands on its tile; cover for the tiles beside it.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK FIVE's own picture for it is in mall_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL, RAIL, HEIGHT, DOOR); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile. A DRESS piece is drawn and never counted: the loose carts, the second stack, the rest of a camp.

mall_mannequins.name: THE MANNEQUINS
mall_mannequins.why: COOK FIVE waits on this legend line (handoffs/COOK_FIVE.md, 11/18): the main piece of the store tile 'display' (low cover), laid at (0.5, 0.75), about a tile wide. THE RUNWAY LIVES HERE. A stand-in until the picture is in mall_art.json under this name.

mall_fountain.name: THE FOUNTAIN, DRY
mall_fountain.why: COOK FIVE waits on this legend line: the atrium layout's blocker in the lift's place (the food court keeps the lift), laid at (0.5, 0.92), a tile. A stand-in until the picture is in mall_art.json under this name.

say.height: The bridge: you hit down easier, and a gun reaches a tile more.

start_why: NOBODY HOLDS THE BRIDGE AT THE BELL: both lines start on the concourse's floor, and the bridge over the atrium, in the middle, is whoever walks up a dead escalator first. (The convention hall's mezzanine is theirs at the bell; the mall's is not.)

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the mall's painted sky and its skylight over the board at this alpha (10%, never past the fight's own most). 'src' is the picture COOK FIVE makes (see garage.json's ceiling); 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in.
